peers.name: review-animations
peers.description: Reviews animation and motion code against a high craft bar derived from Emil Kowalski's design engineering philosophy. Default to flagging; approval is earned.

peers.name: apple-design
peers.description: Apple's approach to interface design and fluid, physical motion, translated for the web. Use when building or reviewing gesture-driven UI, spring animations, drag/swipe/sheet interactions, momentum and interruptible transitions, translucent materials and depth, typography (optical sizing, tracking, leading), reduced-motion, or the design foundations (feedback, spatial consistency, restraint) behind Apple-style interfaces.

peers.name: animation-vocabulary
peers.description: Reverse-lookup glossary that turns a vague description of a web animation or motion effect into its exact term ("the bouncy thing when a popover opens" → Pop in; "the iOS rubber-band scroll" → Rubber-banding). Use when the user asks "what's it called when…", or describes a motion effect without knowing its name and wants the right word to prompt an AI or designer with. For naming an effect, not designing or building one.

peers.name: improve-animations
peers.description: Survey a codebase's animation and motion code as a senior motion advisor, then produce a prioritized audit and self-contained implementation plans for other agents (or cheaper models) to execute. Read-only on source code — it plans improvements, it does not apply them. Use when the user asks to "improve the animations", "audit the motion", "make this app feel better", or wants a roadmap of animation fixes rather than a review of a single diff.

en.tagline: Polish and animation decisions for UI components
en.summary: This skill guides UI component work on interaction details: press and hover states, popover origin, tooltip timing, transitions vs keyframes, clip-path effects, and drag behavior. It gives a decision order for whether to animate, why, which easing, and how long. It also sets a review format that lists each issue as a Before/After table row.
problem: Interaction details such as easing, duration, transform origin, and press feedback are often left at browser defaults. The result is UI that feels slow, delayed, or jarring, and users may not know why.

With this skill, the agent answers a fixed set of questions before it writes animation code. Each animation needs a frequency check, a purpose, an easing choice, and a duration. Reviews show each problem and its fix in one table.
fit: Reviewing a component's press, hover, and popover behavior
Choosing between CSS transitions and keyframes for rapidly changing UI like toasts
unfit: Tasks that a narrower, more specific skill already covers
Functional views where animation adds nothing, such as data-heavy screens, or backend-only work
steps: The skill first asks how often a user will see the animation, and it removes animation from actions repeated many times a day.
Each animation must have a stated purpose, such as feedback, state change, or spatial consistency.
Easing is chosen by element type, with a custom ease-out for entering and exiting elements and ease-in-out for movement on screen.
Duration is set by element, with UI animations kept under 300ms and modals and drawers allowed up to 500ms.
Component rules apply next, such as scale(0.97) on :active, popovers that scale from their trigger, and transitions for interruptible UI.
When reviewing code, the agent returns a single markdown table with Before, After, and Why columns, one row per issue.

zh.tagline: 界面组件的交互打磨与动效决策
zh.summary: 这个技能指导界面组件中的交互细节，包括按下和悬停状态、弹出层的起点、提示框的时机、过渡与关键帧的选择、clip-path 效果以及拖拽行为。它给出一套决策顺序，说明是否需要动画、原因、缓动曲线和时长。评审时，它要求把每个问题写成一行 Before/After 表格。
problem: 缓动、时长、变换原点和按下反馈等交互细节，往往保留浏览器默认值。结果是界面显得迟缓、突兀，用户也说不清原因。
使用这个技能后，智能体在写动画代码前先回答一组固定问题：这个动画多久出现一次，目的是什么，用哪种缓动，持续多长时间。评审结果则用一张表列出每个问题和对应修改。
fit: 检查组件的按下、悬停和弹出层行为
在 Toast 这类频繁变化的界面中，在 CSS 过渡和关键帧之间做选择
加入按速度滑动关闭的拖拽交互
unfit: 已有更专门的技能覆盖的任务
动画没有作用的功能性界面，例如数据密集的页面，或纯后端工作
steps: 技能首先询问用户多久会看到一次这个动画，对每天重复很多次的操作则去掉动画。
每个动画都必须有明确目的，例如反馈、状态变化或空间连贯性。
按元素类型选择缓动：进入和离开的元素用自定义 ease-out，屏幕内移动的元素用 ease-in-out。
按元素设定时长，界面动画控制在 300 毫秒以内，模态框和抽屉可放宽到 500 毫秒。
接着应用组件规则，例如 :active 时使用 scale(0.97)、弹出层从触发元素处展开、可被打断的界面使用过渡。
评审代码时，智能体返回一张 Markdown 表格，包含 Before、After 和 Why 三列，每个问题占一行。
